title: VTG Libbey Shot Glass 3" Tall Heavy Bottom
descriptionText: This VTG Libbey Shot Glass is a vintage collectible featuring a beveled pattern and a heavy bottom for stability. Standing at 3 inches tall, this round shot glass is perfect for all occasions and is made of clear normal glass. The mid-century modern style adds a touch of nostalgia to any barware collection. Hand wash only to maintain its original quality. Made by the reputable brand Libbey, this shot glass is a unique and stylish addition to any home bar setup.
